headline: Disappointment over net salaries in Greece - Analyses show convergence with the Balkans - Dnews
summary: An ENYPEKK analysis says net salaries in Greece have diverged from the eurozone in recent years and are converging faster with Bulgaria and Romania. The analysis describes the results as disappointing.
why: Wage levels shape labour costs, consumer purchasing power and competitiveness for employers. Persistent gaps versus the eurozone matter for investment and labour-market decisions.
